title: Machine-Certified Lean 4 Formalization of the General Divisor Theorem: Exact Density Correction under Residue Conditioning
description: Standalone machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the General Divisor Theorem (GDT) across GeneralDivisorTheorem.lean, VolkanBridge.lean, and DensityBridge.lean (39 kernel-checked theorems and lemmas, 0 custom axioms, 0 sorry). Proves exact minimal period T_min = lcm(m, rad(N)), sharp admissibility gcd(a, d) = 1, the Euler product correction factor C(N, m) = d / phi(d), and the exact per-period count #{0 <= n < T_min : n === a (mod m), gcd(n, N) = 1} = phi(R) via affine units over ZMod R. Includes exhaustive Python verification suites.
